gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-encode-sans-expan: Wide, friendly sans letters with tips pulled well apart make Encode Sans Expanded easy to take in. Encode Sans Expanded sits under Bellota Text, whose bold, uniform-stroke letters carry the weight while the body stays low and quiet.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-encode-sans-sc: Bellota Text draws every stroke ending at the same measured thickness, giving headings a bold, distinctive stamp. Encode Sans SC stays low beneath it, with a shallow terminal curl and a wide gap, so the contrast in weight is the pair's best trick.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-encode-sans-semi-: Bellota Text looks as if it were lettered with a marker tip, bold and open with no shading to steer the eye. Encode Sans Semi Condensed follows in a modern sans-serif, its s opening up wide, so extended reading feels smooth and unfussy.

Commanding is how Bellota Text lands, its terminals finishing at exactly the width they started. Encode Sans Semi Expanded brings the pair's strongest quality: rounded, open sans letters that stay quiet and low while the heading does the shouting.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-exo: Approachable and crisp, Exo keeps wide gaps in its sans letters, which makes a lovely quiet partner for Bellota Text with its neon-tube strokes. Their strongest quality is the difference in weight.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-exo-2: Exo 2 brings curves with plenty of daylight inside, a low-key sans that never crowds the page beneath Bellota Text. And Bellota Text, with no swelling mid-curve, keeps its bold voice, so a long read moves along smoothly.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-faculty-glyphic: Faculty Glyphic reads modern and clear, its rounded letters left wide open and low in presence. Faculty Glyphic then carries a longer passage gently beneath Bellota Text, whose curves have no stress anywhere and stay bold up top.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-figtree: Bellota Text looks drawn with a marker tip, bold and open, with no calligraphic shading anywhere in it. Figtree follows in a plain sans with a wide gap at the e terminal, so a longer passage reads smoothly and without fuss.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-finlandica: Commanding in its bold, open letters, Bellota Text really earns its place big and short, up top. Finlandica stays low beneath it.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-fustat: Fustat reads like bent rope or tubing, with a clear wide gap where the c ends, modern and low. And Bellota Text above it keeps its bold, open shapes, so a longer passage in the plain sans moves along easily.
